classification: Assistant read-only review of every displayed candidate answer against frozen paragraphs and key; no external-world fact check or score overrides
relevance_definition: DIRECT means the quote directly answers at least the requested fact/facet; PARTIAL_NAME identifies surname only; OFF_TOPIC_FOR_REQUESTED_FACT does not answer requested fact. Counts do not certify semantic entailment or all question quantifiers.
metric_limitations: Paragraph containment is not semantic relevance: section C04 extra military citation remains frozen PASS but is independently flagged.
F11 correct surname is partial identification, while the frozen full-name span rule remains FAIL.
F09 original question/gold annotation is broad; F19 most-tourists quantifier is stronger than particularly-golf source wording.
Public SQuAD data may have model exposure; repeated fictional templates are constructed controls, not independent external questions.
